enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close both eyes. Turn onto the left side. Keep the arms bent under the pillow. Remain still. Turn onto the back. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn onto the right side. Extend the right arm under the pillow. Remain still. Turn onto the left side again. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Keep the eyes closed. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open both eyes. Sit up on the bed. Push the blanket aside. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Lift the toothbrush to the mouth. Brush the upper teeth. Brush the lower teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Turn off the tap. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread on the counter. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put the slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the cabinet. Take out a plate. Put the plate on the counter. Open the cabinet again. Take out a glass. Put the glass on the counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Open the microwave door. Crack two eggs into a bowl. Place the bowl into the microwave. Close the microwave door. Press the start button. Wait for the toaster to pop up. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Open the microwave door. Take out the bowl. Close the microwave door. Take a fork from the drawer. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Cut the eggs with the fork. Lift the fork to the mouth. Chew the food. Drink the milk from the glass. Pick up a slice of toast. Bite the toast. Chew the toast. Finish the toast. Pick up the plate. Stand up. Walk to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Put the plate into the dishwasher. Place the glass into the dishwasher. Close the dishwasher door. Wipe the table with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the work uniform. Lay the uniform on the bed. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the work shirt. Button up the shirt. Put on the trousers. Pull up the zipper. Fasten the belt. Put on the socks. Put on the shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Walk to the desk. Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the power button. Check the screen. Put the phone into the pocket. Pick up the work bag from the chair. Open the bag. Put a notebook into the bag. Put a pen into the bag. Put the stethoscope into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Lift the bag onto the shoulder. Turn off the desk lamp. Turn off the bedroom light. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the house. Close the front door. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the pocket. Walk along the sidewalk. Wait at the crosswalk. Press the crossing button. Cross the street when the signal turns green. Keep walking along the sidewalk. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Look at the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Stand near the door. Look at the stop display. Step off the bus. Walk along the street. Walk to the hospital entrance. Push the entrance door open. Walk into the hospital. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Put the bag into the locker. Close the locker. Walk to the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the nurse station. Pick up the patient chart. Read the chart. Put the chart down. Walk to the first patient room. Knock on the door. Push the door open. Greet the patient. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the numbers on the display. Remove the cuff from the arm. Pick up the thermometer. Place the thermometer under the patient's tongue. Wait for the reading. Take out the thermometer. Write the readings on the chart. Pick up the stethoscope. Place the earpieces in the ears. Place the chest piece on the patient's chest. Listen to the breathing. Remove the stethoscope. Hang the stethoscope around the neck. Speak to the patient about the medication. Turn to the bedside table. Pick up the medicine cup. Hand the cup to the patient. Pick up the water cup. Hand it to the patient. Take back the empty cups. Walk to the sink. Wash both hands with soap. Dry the hands with a paper towel. Walk to the next patient room. Knock on the door. Push the door open. Walk to the bedside. Adjust the infusion drip rate with both hands. Check the IV line. Write notes on the chart. Walk back to the nurse station. Put the chart on the desk. Sit down on the chair. Type the patient notes on the computer keyboard. Press the save key. Stand up. Walk to the supply cabinet. Open the cabinet door. Take out gloves. Put the gloves into the pocket. Close the cabinet door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the break room. Open the locker. Take out the lunch box. Close the locker. Walk to the table. Sit down on the chair. Open the lunch box lid. Pick up the fork. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew the food. Drink water from the bottle. Continue eating. Close the lunch box lid. Stand up. Walk to the sink. Rinse the fork under the tap. Put the fork into the lunch box. Walk to the locker. Open the locker. Put the lunch box inside. Close the locker. Walk to the restroom. Turn on the tap. Wash both hands with soap. Dry the hands with a paper towel. Turn off the tap. Walk back to the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work and patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the nurse station. Pick up the chart. Walk to the patient room. Knock on the door. Push the door open. Walk to the bedside. Check the IV line. Adjust the drip rate with both hands. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button. Read the monitor display. Remove the cuff. Write the numbers on the chart. Pick up the thermometer. Place it under the patient's tongue. Wait for the reading. Take the thermometer out. Record the temperature. Walk to the medicine cart. Push the cart down the corridor. Stop at the patient room. Pick up the medicine cup. Hand the cup to the patient. Pick up the water cup. Hand it to the patient. Take back the cups. Push the cart to the next room. Pick up the chart. Write the medication record. Walk to the computer. Sit down. Type the patient record on the keyboard. Press the enter key. Stand up. Walk to the supply room. Open the cabinet. Take out bandages. Close the cabinet. Walk to the patient room. Place the bandage on the dressing trolley. Put on gloves. Clean the wound with a gauze pad. Place a new dressing over the wound. Press the tape down. Remove the gloves. Drop the gloves into the bin. Wash both hands with soap. Dry the hands. Write the dressing note on the chart. Walk back to the nurse station. Hand over the chart to the colleague. Speak to the colleague about the shift handover.

Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take out the bag. Take out the coat. Put on the coat. Close the locker. Lift the bag onto the shoulder. Walk to the exit. Push the exit door open. Walk along the street. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Look at the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on a seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Look at the stop display. Stand up. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Wait at the crosswalk. Cross the street. Walk to the house. Take the key out of the pocket. Unlock the front door. Push the door open. Walk inside. Close the door. Lock the door. Put the key into the pocket. Take off the shoes. Put the shoes on the shoe rack. Walk into the kitchen.

Walk into the kitchen. Put the bag on the chair. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the meat. Close the refrigerator door. Put the vegetables on the cutting board. Open the drawer. Take out a knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Put the knife down. Turn on the induction cooker. Place the pan on the cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Put the meat into the pan. Stir the meat with a spatula. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir the food with the spatula. Add salt from the shaker. Turn off the induction cooker. Take a plate from the cabinet. Slide the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew the food. Drink water from the glass. Continue eating. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Put the plate into the dishwasher. Wipe the counter with a cloth.

Walk into the living room. Pick up the remote control from the table. Press the power button on the remote. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Place both feet on the floor. Press the channel button on the remote. Look at the TV screen. Press the volume button. Put the remote on the sofa armrest. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Look at the screen. Swipe the screen with the thumb. Put the phone on the table. Pick up the remote again. Press the channel button. Look at the TV screen. Cross the legs. Press the volume button. Put the remote on the table. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Open the bottle cap. Drink water. Close the bottle cap. Put the bottle on the table. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Put the remote on the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Pick up the laundry basket. Put the basket on the floor. Open the washing machine door. Take the clothes out of the basket. Put the clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button on the washing machine. Press the program button. Press the start button. Stand up. Pick up the empty basket. Walk to Bedroom 1. Put the basket on the floor. Walk back to the bathroom. Open the cabinet. Take out the clothes dryer sheets. Close the cabinet. Wait near the washing machine. Listen to the machine. Press the pause button. Open the washing machine door. Check the drum. Close the door. Press the start button again. Wait for the cycle to finish. Press the power button to switch off the machine.

Walk into the living room. Pick up the remote control from the table. Put the remote into the drawer. Pick up the water bottle from the table. Carry the bottle to the kitchen. Put the bottle into the refrigerator. Walk back to the living room. Pick up the cushion from the floor. Put the cushion on the sofa. Pick up the magazine from the table. Put the magazine on the shelf. Pick up the vacuum cleaner from the corner. Press the power button. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pull the vacuum cleaner back. Press the power button to switch off. Put the vacuum cleaner back in the corner. Straighten the sofa cover with both hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal browsing and planning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the power button on the computer. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse on the desk. Click the browser icon. Type the web address on the keyboard. Press the enter key. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Read the screen. Click a link. Scroll the page. Open a new tab. Type words in the search bar. Press the enter key. Read the results. Click the calendar icon. Type notes on the keyboard. Press the save key. Open the email page. Type a reply on the keyboard. Press the send button. Close the browser window. Click the shutdown button. Wait for the screen to turn off. Push the chair back. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Open the shower door. Step into the shower. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature with the handle. Wet the hair under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Rinse the body under the water. Turn off the shower tap. Open the shower door. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the hair with the towel. Wipe the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Put on the sleepwear. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Put the toothbrush back. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the TV on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pick up the remote control from the desk. Press the power button. Sit on the bed. Lean back against the headboard. Place both legs under the blanket. Press the channel button on the remote. Look at the TV screen. Press the volume button. Put the remote on the bedside table. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Look at the screen. Swipe the screen with the thumb. Put the phone back on the bedside table. Press the volume button on the remote. Look at the TV screen. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Put the remote on the bedside table. Turn off the desk lamp. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body.

Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close both eyes. Turn onto the right side. Bend the arms under the pillow. Remain still. Turn onto the back. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn onto the left side. Extend the left arm on the pillow. Remain still. Keep the eyes closed. Remain still.
